problem: The complete AI Modelwijzer v2 passed content/governance checks but Netlify production builds failed with exit code 2.
root_cause: Four current Dutch governance strings were not present as exact keys in the fail-closed static English translation cache. Similar or combined translations existed, but build-localized-routes requires exact source-string coverage when STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1.
fix: Add the four exact source strings to the canonical Modelwijzer v2 static i18n cache and regression-test their presence.
prevention: Every new or changed public Dutch string introduced on Modelwijzer governance surfaces must have an exact static English cache entry in the same lineage.
Similar wording is not accepted as cache coverage because the translator keys exact normalized source strings.
Keep production translation generation fail-closed when network translation is disabled.
